Warrior.root: Root passive (always active): 16% reduced damage taken - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.text: Grants a chance to block incoming hits, halving their damage - 8% at rank 1, +6% per additional rank (20% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Aegis
specializations.text: A blocked hit also shields your lowest-HP ally for 20% of the blocked damage, at rank 1 - +10% per rank (40% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Bastion
modifiers.text: Aegis's shield lasts 1 additional second per rank (up to +3s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Rally
modifiers.text: Aegis also grants the shielded ally +10% attack speed per rank for its duration (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Iron Circle
modifiers.text: Aegis shields 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

specializations.name: Spike Barrier
specializations.text: A blocked hit reflects 25% of its damage back at the attacker at rank 1 - +15% per rank (55% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Thorned Hide
modifiers.text: Spike Barrier's reflected damage also applies a stacking -5% damage dealt debuff to the attacker per rank (up to -15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Retribution
modifiers.text: Reflected damage has a 20% chance per rank (up to 60% at 3/3) to crit for double.

modifiers.name: Unyielding
modifiers.text: Spike Barrier can also trigger on unblocked hits, at a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Unbreakable
specializations.text: Block chance overflow past the 75% cap converts to increased damage at 50% efficiency per rank - +25% per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree block chance, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

modifiers.name: Fortress
modifiers.text: Unbreakable's overflow conversion also grants flat damage reduction - 2% per rank (up to 6% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Second Skin
modifiers.text: Blocking reduces incoming damage by 65% per rank instead of the base 50% (75% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Stonewall
modifiers.text: The first hit each fight is automatically blocked - rank 2 extends this to the first 2 hits, rank 3 to the first 3.

skills.name: Retaliation
skills.text: A hit taken has a chance to trigger an immediate counter-attack - 10% at rank 1, +8% per additional rank (26% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Vengeance
specializations.text: Retaliation's counter-attacks deal 20% increased damage at rank 1 - +15% per rank (50% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Grudge
modifiers.text: Vengeance gains +5% damage per rank (up to +15% at 3/3) for each prior hit from the SAME attacker this fight, stacking up to 5 times.

modifiers.name: Executioner's Mark
modifiers.text: Vengeance's counter-attacks gain +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Payback
modifiers.text: Vengeance's counter always crits when the attacker is below 30% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 raises the threshold to 45% HP.

specializations.name: Bloodied Resolve
specializations.text: Retaliation's counter-attacks heal you for 8% of the damage dealt at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Adrenaline Surge
modifiers.text: A successful Retaliation also grants +8% attack speed per rank for 3s (up to +24% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Hardened
modifiers.text: Each Retaliation this fight grants a stacking +2% damage reduction per rank (up to 5 stacks, +6%/stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Second Wind
modifiers.text: Retaliation's trigger chance doubles below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 raises the threshold to 65% HP.

specializations.name: Last Stand
specializations.text: Below 25% HP, Retaliation's trigger chance is increased by 25% at rank 1 - +15% per rank (55% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Defiance
modifiers.text: While Last Stand is active, gain +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Undying Will
modifiers.text: Can't be reduced below 1 HP once per fight while under 25% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 grants a second use.

modifiers.name: Berserk Vigor
modifiers.text: While Last Stand is active, also gain +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

skills.name: Juggernaut
skills.text: Increases max HP by 8% per rank (up to 24% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Colossus
specializations.text: Juggernaut's max HP bonus is increased by 50% at rank 1 - +25% per rank (100% more at 3/3) - e.g. at 3/3 Juggernaut alone (24%) becomes 48% total.

modifiers.name: Titan's Grip
modifiers.text: Converts 33% of Juggernaut and Colossus's own combined max HP bonus into increased damage per rank (up to 100% at 3/3), applied MULTIPLICATIVELY on top of your other damage bonuses rather than adding into them - your gear's own max HP bonuses don't count toward this.

modifiers.name: Immovable
modifiers.text: Reduces damage taken from enemy critical hits by 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Endless Reserves
modifiers.text: Increases healing received from allies by 5% per rank (up to 15% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Momentum
specializations.text: Each hit lands a stacking +3% attack speed buff per rank for 4s, max 5 stacks - up to +9% per stack at 3/3 (45% at cap).

modifiers.name: Rampage
modifiers.text: Momentum's stacks last 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Avalanche
modifiers.text: Each Momentum stack also adds +2% increased damage per rank (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unstoppable
modifiers.text: Momentum gains 1 additional max stack per rank (up to 8 stacks at 3/3, from the base 5).

specializations.name: Overwhelming Force
specializations.text: Converts 10% of your current damage reduction into increased damage per rank (up to 30% at 3/3), on top of the existing overflow conversion.

modifiers.name: Grim Resolve
modifiers.text: Overwhelming Force's conversion efficiency is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Momentous Blow
modifiers.text: Overwhelming Force also applies to block chance, at half efficiency per rank (up to half at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Onslaught
modifiers.text: Overwhelming Force's damage bonus also grants +5% attack speed per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Berserker.root: Root passive (always active): 28% increased damage dealt / Skill â€” Frenzy: killing blows have a chance to grant an immediate extra attack - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Frenzy
skills.text: Each attack has a 10% chance to strike the same target additional times - rank 1 strikes twice total, rank 2 strikes three times total, rank 3 strikes four times total. The 10% rate itself doesn't scale with rank; only the strike count does.

specializations.name: Rising Fury
specializations.text: Frenzy's trigger chance is increased by 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3, on top of the base 10%).

modifiers.name: Frenzied Assault
modifiers.text: Rising Fury's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3, on top of Rising Fury's own +15%).

modifiers.name: Blood Scent
modifiers.text: Frenzy's trigger chance doubles against enemies at or below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 raises this threshold to 65% HP.

modifiers.name: Overkill
modifiers.text: Each Frenzy extra strike reduces the target's damage reduction by 10% per rank for that hit (up to -30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Berserking
specializations.text: Frenzy's extra strikes deal 10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Overrun
modifiers.text: Berserking's damage bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, on top of Berserking's own +30%).

modifiers.name: Culling Strike
modifiers.text: Any Frenzy strike against an enemy at or below 2% HP per rank (up to 6% at 3/3) instead outright kills them.

modifiers.name: Chain Frenzy
modifiers.text: A Frenzy trigger has a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3) to trigger Frenzy again on the same target - capped at 1 extra chain per point invested here (up to 3 extra chains at 3/3).

specializations.name: Bloodletting
specializations.text: Each Frenzy strike heals you for 3% of the damage it deals per rank (up to 9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Vitality Surge
modifiers.text: Bloodletting's heal is increased by another 3% of damage dealt per rank (up to +9% at 3/3, on top of Bloodletting's own +9%).

modifiers.name: Bloodshield
modifiers.text: A Bloodletting heal has a 15% chance per rank (up to 45% at 3/3) to also grant a shield worth 20% of the heal.

modifiers.name: Undying Fury
modifiers.text: Can't be reduced below 1 HP once per fight, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 grants a second use.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.text: Each hit you land grants a stacking +4% increased damage buff for 5s, max 5 stacks, at rank 1 - +2% per rank (+8% per stack at 3/3, up to 40% total at cap).

specializations.name: Unending Rage
specializations.text: Bloodlust's stacks last 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Fury Unleashed
modifiers.text: Bloodlust's per-stack damage bonus is increased by 1% per rank (up to +3% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Neverending
modifiers.text: Bloodlust's stacks decay one at a time instead of all at once, per rank (fully gradual at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Warlord
modifiers.text: Reaching max Bloodlust stacks grants party members +3% increased damage per rank for 5s (up to +9% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Overwhelm
specializations.text: Bloodlust stacks also reduce the target's damage reduction by 3% per rank per stack (up to -9% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Shatter
modifiers.text: Overwhelm's damage reduction shred also applies to block chance, by the same amount per rank.

modifiers.name: Exposed
modifiers.text: Overwhelm's effect lingers 1 additional second per rank after Bloodlust falls off (up to +3s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Crush
modifiers.text: Overwhelm's shred is doubled against enemies already below 50% damage reduction, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%.

specializations.name: Frenzied Blows
specializations.text: Bloodlust stacks also grant +2% attack speed per rank per stack (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Hurricane
modifiers.text: Frenzied Blows' attack speed bonus also grants +3% splash per rank per stack (up to +9% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Tempo
modifiers.text: Frenzied Blows grants 1 free stack on entering combat per rank (up to 3 free stacks at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Windfury
modifiers.text: Frenzied Blows has a chance to grant 2 stacks instead of 1 on hit - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

skills.name: Reckless Swing
skills.text: Deal 15% more damage at rank 1 in exchange for taking 8% more damage - +10%/+5% per additional rank (35% more dealt / 18% more taken at 3/3).

specializations.name: Death Wish
specializations.text: Reckless Swing's trade is increased by another 10% dealt / 5% taken per rank (up to +30% dealt / +15% taken at 3/3, stacking with its base).

modifiers.name: Glory Hound
modifiers.text: Death Wish's damage bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3), on top of its base trade.

modifiers.name: Reckless Abandon
modifiers.text: Death Wish's extra damage taken is reduced by 5% per rank (up to -15% at 3/3) without losing any of the damage bonus.

modifiers.name: Glorious Death
modifiers.text: A hit that would kill you while Death Wish is active leaves you at 1 HP instead - once per fight at rank 1, twice at rank 3.

specializations.name: Vigor
specializations.text: A kill while Reckless Swing is active heals you for 6% of max HP per rank (up to 18% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Blood Pump
modifiers.text: Vigor's heal is increased by 4% max HP per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Second Gale
modifiers.text: A kill while Reckless Swing is active grants immunity to its extra-damage-taken penalty - 2s per rank (up to 6s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Vengeful Blood
modifiers.text: Vigor's heal also grants a shield worth 50% of the heal per rank (up to 150% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Berserker's Gambit
specializations.text: Gain +5% crit chance per rank for every 20% max HP missing (up to +15% per 20% missing at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Last Laugh
modifiers.text: Gambit's crit chance bonus is doubled while below 25% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 also doubles crit damage in that state.

modifiers.name: Rage Fueled
modifiers.text: Gambit's unused crit chance (above 80% HP, where missing-HP scaling can't apply) converts to +5% attack speed per rank instead (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Death Defiant
modifiers.text: Gambit's crit bonus persists 3 additional seconds per rank after healing back above its missing-HP threshold (up to 9s at 3/3). (inactive)

Rogue.root: Root passive (always active): 7% crit chance - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Opportunist
skills.text: Your first hit each fight cannot be evaded or blocked - rank 2 extends this to your first 2 hits, rank 3 to your first 3.

specializations.name: Ambush
specializations.text: Your guaranteed hits (see Opportunist) also ignore 33% of the target's damage reduction at rank 1 - +33% per rank (up to ~100% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Opening Move
modifiers.text: Adds a cooldown to Opportunist, letting your next hit use Opportunist's and Ambush's bonuses once every 4/3/2 seconds.

modifiers.name: Cold Steel
modifiers.text: Leaves a debuff on the target making the next hit from any ally also gain Opportunist's and Ambush's bonuses, at a 33%/66%/100% effectiveness rate.

modifiers.name: Predator
modifiers.text: Marks any enemy struck by an opportunity attack to take 10%/20%/30% increased damage from all hits for 4 seconds.

specializations.name: Cutthroat
specializations.text: Crits against enemies below 25% HP deal 15% more damage per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Marked for Death
modifiers.text: Cutthroat also marks the target, causing your next hits to count as crits against it - 2 hits at rank 2, 3 hits at rank 3.

modifiers.name: Bloody Knife
modifiers.text: Cutthroat's damage bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Final Cut
modifiers.text: A Cutthroat crit that kills grants +5% attack speed per rank for 3s (up to +15% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Vanish
specializations.text: A crit grants +10% evasion per rank for 3s (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Smokescreen
modifiers.text: Vanish also grants your lowest-HP ally +5% evasion per rank for its duration (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Fadeaway
modifiers.text: Vanish's duration is increased by 1s per rank (up to +3s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Backstab
modifiers.text: While Vanish is active, your next hit deals +15% damage per rank (up to +45% at 3/3).

skills.name: Deadly Precision
skills.text: Increases crit damage dealt by 15% at rank 1 - +10% per rank (35% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Exploit Weakness
specializations.text: Crit multiplier bonus is increased by 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3) against enemies below 50% HP.

modifiers.name: Vital Strike
modifiers.text: Exploit Weakness's threshold is raised to include enemies below 65% HP per rank instead of 50% (up to 80% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Weak Point
modifiers.text: Exploit Weakness also grants +5% crit chance per rank (up to +15% at 3/3) against affected enemies.

modifiers.name: Surgical Strike
modifiers.text: Exploit Weakness's bonus crit multiplier also applies to splash damage, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 doubles the splash portion specifically.

specializations.name: Twin Strikes
specializations.text: A crit has a chance to immediately strike again at 50% damage - 15% at rank 1, +15% per rank (45% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Echo
modifiers.text: Twin Strikes' second-hit damage is increased from 50% per rank (up to 95% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Flurry
modifiers.text: Twin Strikes' trigger chance is increased by 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, 75% total at 3/3 combined with its base).

modifiers.name: Double Tap
modifiers.text: Twin Strikes' second hit can itself crit and re-trigger Twin Strikes again, at a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Assassinate
specializations.text: Once per fight, your next hit is a guaranteed crit - unlocked at rank 2, rank 3 grants a second use.

modifiers.name: Coup de Grace
modifiers.text: Assassinate's guaranteed crit also deals +30% crit damage per rank (up to +90% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Premeditation
modifiers.text: Assassinate refunds its use if the triggering hit doesn't kill, at a 20% chance per rank (up to 60% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Silent Blade
modifiers.text: Assassinate's guaranteed crit also grants +20% evasion per rank for 3s afterward (up to +60% at 3/3).

skills.name: Shadowstep
skills.text: Increases evasion by 8% at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Fleetfoot
specializations.text: Each successful evade grants a stacking +5% attack speed per rank for 3s, max 3 stacks (up to +15% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Windrunner
modifiers.text: Fleetfoot's max stacks are increased by 1 per rank (up to 6 stacks at 3/3, from the base 3).

modifiers.name: Silent Steps
modifiers.text: Fleetfoot's stacks also grant +3% evasion per rank per stack (up to +9% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Quickdraw
modifiers.text: Fleetfoot grants free stacks on entering combat - 1 at rank 2, 2 at rank 3.

specializations.name: Elusive
specializations.text: Evasion overflow past the 75% cap converts to crit chance at 25% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

modifiers.name: Phantom
modifiers.text: A second, independent conversion channel off the same evasion overflow Elusive draws from - crit chance at 10% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Elusive's own cap for up to +60% total).

modifiers.name: Duskveil
modifiers.text: Elusive also converts overflow into attack speed, at 25% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% attack speed per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Voidstep
modifiers.text: An evaded hit has a chance to trigger an immediate free attack against the attacker - 10% per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Nightstalker
specializations.text: Evasion is increased by 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3) specifically against boss attacks.

modifiers.name: Hunter's Instinct
modifiers.text: Nightstalker also grants +5% crit chance per rank (up to +15% at 3/3) against bosses.

modifiers.name: Apex Predator
modifiers.text: Nightstalker's evasion bonus vs bosses is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Silent Killer
modifiers.text: The first hit landed against a boss each fight deals +25% damage per rank (up to +75% at 3/3).

Monk.root: Root passive (always active): 13% evasion - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Flowing Strikes
skills.text: Each consecutive hit on the same target grants a stacking +3% attack speed for 4s, max 5 stacks, at rank 1 - +1% per rank (+5% per stack at 3/3, 25% at cap).

specializations.name: Hundred Fists
specializations.text: Flowing Strikes' max stacks are increased by 2 per rank (up to 11 stacks at 3/3, from the base 5).

specializations.name: Pressure Point
specializations.text: Flowing Strikes' stacks also grant +2% crit chance per rank per stack (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Nerve Strike
modifiers.text: Pressure Point's crits also deal +10% crit damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Vital Points
modifiers.text: Pressure Point's stacks also reduce the target's damage reduction by 2% per rank per stack (up to -6% per stack at 3/3).

modifiers.name: One Hundred Hands
modifiers.text: A crit from Pressure Point has a chance to not consume a Flowing Strikes stack - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3). (inactive)

specializations.name: Relentless Assault
specializations.text: Landing a hit while at max Flowing Strikes stacks refreshes their duration, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 extends the base duration by 2s.

modifiers.name: Eternal Flow
modifiers.text: Relentless Assault's refresh also adds 1 additional stack per rank (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unending Cycle
modifiers.text: Relentless Assault's extended duration is increased by another 1s per rank (up to +3s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Stormfront
modifiers.text: While at max Flowing Strikes stacks, gain +5% splash per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

skills.name: Inner Focus
skills.text: Successfully evading a hit heals you for 3% of max HP at rank 1 - +2% per rank (7% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Meditation
specializations.text: Inner Focus's heal is increased by 1% max HP per rank for every 10% evasion you have (up to +3% per 10% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Inner Peace
modifiers.text: Meditation's heal-per-evasion scaling is increased by another 0.5% max HP per rank (up to +1.5% per 10% evasion at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Rising Tide
modifiers.text: Meditation also grants +3% healing power per rank for 3s after triggering (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Clarity
modifiers.text: Meditation also triggers on blocked hits, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 also triggers it on hits reduced by Iron Body.

specializations.name: Chi Burst
specializations.text: Inner Focus also heals your lowest-HP ally for 50% of the amount per rank (up to 150% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Sanctuary
modifiers.text: Chi Burst's ally heal is increased by another 25% per rank (up to +75% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Harmonize
modifiers.text: Chi Burst also grants the healed ally +5% damage reduction per rank for 3s (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Wide Circle
modifiers.text: Chi Burst heals 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

specializations.name: Serenity
specializations.text: Evading a hit also grants +5% damage reduction per rank for 3s (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unshakable
modifiers.text: Serenity's damage reduction bonus duration is increased by 1s per rank (up to +3s at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Stillwater
modifiers.text: Serenity triggers guaranteed on your first evade each fight - rank 2 extends this to your 2nd evade, rank 3 to your 3rd.

modifiers.name: Unmovable
modifiers.text: Serenity's damage reduction bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

skills.name: Iron Body
skills.text: Increases evasion by 6% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (14% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Stone Fist
specializations.text: Evasion overflow past the 75% cap converts to increased damage at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

modifiers.name: Granite Skin
modifiers.text: A second, independent conversion channel off the same evasion overflow Stone Fist draws from - increased damage at 15% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Stone Fist's own cap for up to +60% total).

modifiers.name: Earthen Will
modifiers.text: Stone Fist also converts a portion of overflow into max HP, at 25% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% max HP per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Counterflow
modifiers.text: An evaded hit has a chance to trigger a free counter-attack - 10% per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Unbroken
specializations.text: Evasion overflow past the 75% cap converts into ignoring enemies' own evasion, at 10% efficiency per rank (up to 30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

modifiers.name: Last Bastion
modifiers.text: Unbroken's evasion bonus is increased by another 5% per 20% missing HP, per rank (up to +15% per 20% at 3/3). (inactive)

modifiers.name: Rising Defiance
modifiers.text: Unbroken also grants +5% increased damage per rank at the same missing-HP thresholds (up to +15% per 20% missing at 3/3). (inactive)

modifiers.name: Unyielding Spirit
modifiers.text: Below 25% HP, Unbroken's bonus is doubled - per rank this activation threshold instead raises to 35%/45%/55% HP (55% at 3/3). (inactive)

specializations.name: Temple Guardian
specializations.text: Iron Body also grants your lowest-HP ally +5% evasion per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Shared Strength
modifiers.text: Temple Guardian protects 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Iron Will
modifiers.text: Temple Guardian's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Guardian Spirit
modifiers.text: Temple Guardian also heals the protected ally for 2% max HP per rank, once every 5s (up to 6% at 3/3).

Paladin.root: Root passive (always active): 55% healing power / 6% intervene - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Guardian's Oath
skills.text: Increases intervene by 4% at rank 1 - +3% per rank (10% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Aegis Ward
specializations.text: Intervene overflow past the 50% cap converts to damage reduction at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree intervene, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 50%.

modifiers.name: Sanctified Armor
modifiers.text: A second, independent conversion channel off the same intervene overflow Aegis Ward draws from - damage reduction at 15% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Aegis Ward's own cap for up to +60% total).

modifiers.name: Bonded Devotion
modifiers.text: Aegis Ward's conversion also grants the intervened ally +5% damage reduction per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Steadfast
modifiers.text: Aegis Ward's damage reduction bonus persists for 2s per rank after intervene stops triggering (up to +6s at 3/3).

specializations.name: Vow of Protection
specializations.text: Guardian's Oath also grants the whole party +3% damage reduction per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Beacon of Light
modifiers.text: Vow of Protection's bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Hallowed Ground
modifiers.text: Vow of Protection also reduces damage taken from bosses specifically by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unwavering
modifiers.text: Vow of Protection's bonus doubles for the party while you are below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%. (inactive)

specializations.name: Unbreakable Faith
specializations.text: Damage redirected by intervene heals you for 5% of the redirected amount per rank (up to 15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Martyr's Blessing
modifiers.text: Unbreakable Faith's self-heal is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Aegis of Mercy
modifiers.text: Divine Favor's shield value is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Warding Light
modifiers.text: Divine Favor's shield lasts 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3, from the base 5s).

modifiers.name: Sacred Barrier
modifiers.text: Divine Favor's shield has a chance per rank to also reflect 20% of absorbed damage - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

skills.name: Blessed Resilience
skills.text: Grants the WHOLE party (yourself included) +4% max HP at rank 1 - +3% per rank (10% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Sanctuary
specializations.text: Blessed Resilience also grants the whole party +3% damage reduction per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Consecrated Earth
modifiers.text: Sanctuary's party damage reduction bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Warding Prayer
modifiers.text: Sanctuary also reduces damage taken from bosses specifically by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unyielding Faith
modifiers.text: Sanctuary's bonus doubles for the party while you are below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%. (inactive)

specializations.name: Guardian Spirit
specializations.text: Unlocked at rank 2: once per fight, prevent ANY party member from dying (yourself included) - heals them for 20% max HP instead of letting the killing blow land. Rank 3 grants a second use per fight. Rank 1 alone does nothing yet.

modifiers.name: Second Chance
modifiers.text: Guardian Spirit's save heal is increased by another 8% max HP per rank (up to +24% at 3/3, on top of the base 20%).

modifiers.name: Divine Intervention
modifiers.text: Guardian Spirit's save also grants the saved unit +10% damage reduction per rank for 5s (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Final Blessing
modifiers.text: Guardian Spirit's save also grants the WHOLE party +5% healing power per rank for 5s afterward (up to +15% at 3/3), not just the saved unit.

specializations.name: Radiant Aegis
specializations.text: Blessed Resilience also grants the whole party +4% evasion per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Winds of Grace
modifiers.text: Radiant Aegis's party evasion bonus is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Swift Blessing
modifiers.text: Radiant Aegis also grants the whole party +3% attack speed per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Haloed Steps
modifiers.text: Radiant Aegis's overflow past the 75% cap converts to party damage reduction at 30% efficiency per rank (up to 90% at 3/3).

Druid.root: Root passive (always active): innately hybrid â€” 50% of every attack converts to healing by default / 13% evasion - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Regrowth
skills.text: Increases healing power at the same rate as Cleric's Divine Grace - 20% at rank 1, +16% per rank (52% at 3/3) - PLUS its own separate multiplicative healing power increase on top: +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

specializations.name: Rejuvenation
specializations.text: Regrowth's heals have a chance to also heal a second ally for 50% value - 15% at rank 1, +10% per rank (35% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Blooming Field
modifiers.text: A second, independent multiplicative healing power increase, separate from Regrowth's own - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

modifiers.name: Evergrowth
modifiers.text: Converts a slice of your TOTAL healing power directly into Lingering Effect - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3). E.g. at 1000% healing power, 3/3 Evergrowth alone grants 90% Lingering Effect.

modifiers.name: Seed of Life
modifiers.text: Every tick of your own Lingering Effect heals also grants the target a stacking shield, at the same rate - 10% of the tick's own heal amount at rank 1, +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Wild Surge
specializations.text: Healing Power above 100% already shortens your action interval instead of making individual heals bigger - Wild Surge shortens it FURTHER, by another 8% per rank (up to 24% faster at 3/3, stacking with the base effect). (inactive)

modifiers.name: Overgrowth
modifiers.text: Wild Surge's extra interval reduction is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3). (inactive)

modifiers.name: Primal Force
modifiers.text: A flat, unconditional multiplicative splash increase - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

modifiers.name: Wild Heart
modifiers.text: A slice of any healing you land on someone ELSE also heals you - 10% at rank 1, +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Nature's Blessing
specializations.text: Increases crit chance by 10% at rank 1 - +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Bloom Strike
modifiers.text: A second, independent crit chance increase, on top of Nature's Blessing's own - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Wild Instinct
modifiers.text: Any heal you land also grants its target a temporary multiplicative damage reduction - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3), for 3s.

modifiers.name: Verdant Burst
modifiers.text: If a hit would kill an ally who's currently affected by your own Lingering Effect healing, and your pending Lingering Effect healing on them exceeds the blow's damage, they survive at 1 HP instead. 1 use per fight at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 uses at 3/3).

skills.name: Predator's Instinct
skills.text: Increases evasion by 6% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (14% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Feral Reflexes
specializations.text: Predator's Instinct's bonus is increased by another 6% per rank (up to +18% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Quick Paw
modifiers.text: Feral Reflexes' bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Silent Prowl
modifiers.text: A successful evade grants +10% crit chance per rank on your next hit (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Wild Agility
modifiers.text: Feral Reflexes also grants +3% attack speed per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Shifting Form
specializations.text: Evasion overflow past the 75% cap converts to increased damage at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

modifiers.name: Primal Shift
modifiers.text: A second, independent conversion channel off the same evasion overflow Shifting Form draws from - increased damage at 15% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Shifting Form's own cap for up to +60% total).

modifiers.name: Claw Strike
modifiers.text: Shifting Form also converts a portion of overflow into crit chance, at 20% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Wild Fury
modifiers.text: An evaded hit has a chance to trigger an immediate free attack - 10% per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Pack Instinct
specializations.text: Predator's Instinct also grants your lowest-HP ally +4% evasion per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Pathfinder
modifiers.text: Pack Instinct's bonus is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: United Pack
modifiers.text: Pack Instinct protects 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Wild Guardian
modifiers.text: Pack Instinct also heals the protected ally for 2% max HP per rank, once every 5s (up to 6% at 3/3).

skills.name: Thorned Barrier
skills.text: A multiplicative damage reduction increase - 5% at rank 1, +5% per rank (15% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Living Armor
specializations.text: Thorned Barrier's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Ironbark
modifiers.text: Adds directly to Thorned Barrier's own multiplicative damage reduction - +5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3, 10/20/30% combined total with Thorned Barrier's own).

modifiers.name: Nature's Ward
modifiers.text: A multiplicative damage reduction increase specifically against boss attacks - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unyielding Roots
modifiers.text: Forces every boss attack to target you specifically for 2 out of every 8 seconds at rank 1 - the cycle shortens to every 6s at rank 2, every 4s at rank 3 (same 2s taunt window each time).

specializations.name: Bramblegrowth
specializations.text: A hit reduced by Thorned Barrier reflects 15% of the reduced damage back at the attacker per rank (up to 45% at 3/3). In practice this reads off the hit's TOTAL reduction (all combined DR/block sources, not just Thorned Barrier's own slice) as long as Thorned Barrier is invested - isolating one source's specific share of an already-combined reduction isn't something the combat sim tracks.

modifiers.name: Thornlash
modifiers.text: Bramblegrowth's reflect is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Poison Thorns
modifiers.text: Bramblegrowth's reflect also reduces the attacker's damage dealt by 5% per rank for 3s (up to -15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Entangle
modifiers.text: Bramblegrowth's reflect has a chance per rank to also apply to a second attacker if multiple enemies hit you that turn - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Werebear
specializations.text: Grants Thick Hide: every 6 seconds at rank 1, removes any debuffs enemies have inflicted on you - the cycle shortens to every 5s at rank 2, every 4s at rank 3.

modifiers.name: Rooted Network
modifiers.text: Thick Hide also protects 1 additional party member per rank (up to 3 at 3/3), PLUS 1 more for every 100% splash you have.

modifiers.name: Wild Roar
modifiers.text: Whenever a party member dies, fear every enemy for 1 second (unable to act). 1 use per fight at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 uses at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Nature's Embrace
modifiers.text: Whenever a party member dies, instantly and fully heals the lowest-HP other party members - 1 at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 at 3/3).

Slayer.root: Root passive (always active): 0.11% of damage dealt leeched as life (capped at 20% max hp/sec) / Skill â€” Flicker Strike: every 5s, dashes to 4 random enemies with +100% splash on each hit - shown at level 1; grows with level.

skills.name: Open Wound
skills.text: Hits apply a stacking wound (max 5 stacks, before Blood Debt). Each stack adds 0.4% leech against that target at rank 1, +0.2% per additional rank - 0.6% per stack at rank 2, 0.8% per stack at rank 3 (up to 4.0% total leech at 5 stacks). Blends into your normal life leech, still capped by the same leech-per-second cap.

specializations.name: Festering Wound
specializations.text: Wound stacks last 25% longer at rank 1 (7.5s, up from the base 6s) and spread to your splash targets - +25% per additional rank (75% longer at 3/3, 10.5s).

modifiers.name: Rot
modifiers.text: Wound stacks also reduce enemy healing received by 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Contagion
modifiers.text: A wound has a 25% chance per rank (up to 75% at 3/3) to jump to a new target when its host dies.

modifiers.name: Blood Debt
modifiers.text: Raises max wound stacks by 1 per rank (up to 8 stacks at 3/3, from the base 5).

specializations.name: Hemorrhage
specializations.text: When a wound reaches max stacks, it explodes for 40% of all the damage you've dealt to that target since the wound was first applied, at rank 1 - +20% per additional rank (80% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Overflow
modifiers.text: Hemorrhage's explosion also leeches 20% of its damage for the Slayer, per rank (up to 60% at 3/3). This self-leech bypasses the normal leech-per-second cap.

modifiers.name: Arterial Spray
modifiers.text: The explosion hits 1 additional nearby enemy per rank (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Second Wind
modifiers.text: A 15% chance per rank (up to 45% at 3/3) for the explosion to fully reset Bloodpact's cooldown.

specializations.name: Necrotic Grip
specializations.text: While wounded, an enemy deals 10% less damage per rank (up to -30% at 3/3) on their own hits.

modifiers.name: Withering Touch
modifiers.text: Also reduces wounded enemies' healing received, invested and scaling separately from Rot - 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Plague Bearer
modifiers.text: The damage penalty spreads to 1 additional nearby enemy per rank (up to 3 at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Grave Chill
modifiers.text: Wounded enemies are also slowed by 8% per rank (up to -24% at 3/3).

skills.name: Vampiric Frenzy
skills.text: Reduces FlickerStrike's cooldown by 12% at rank 1 - +8% per additional rank (28% at 3/3, ~3.6s from the base 5s). Folds the real, already-shipped FlickerStrike ability into the tree.

specializations.name: Blood Frenzy
specializations.text: Each FlickerStrike dash grants +15% attack speed per rank for 4s (up to +45% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Unrelenting
modifiers.text: Blood Frenzy's attack speed bonus decays 33% slower per rank - stops decaying entirely at 3/3.

modifiers.name: War Cry
modifiers.text: Blood Frenzy also grants nearby allies +5% attack speed per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Adrenaline
modifiers.text: FlickerStrike's dash hits deal +20% crit damage per rank (up to +60% at 3/3).

specializations.name: Endless Thirst
specializations.text: Each FlickerStrike dash raises your leech cap by +5% max HP/sec per rank for 4s - at 3/3 the cap is removed entirely instead of +15%.

modifiers.name: Overflow Vessel
modifiers.text: Leech beyond the cap becomes a 5-second shield worth 25% of the overcap amount per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Insatiable
modifiers.text: Each FlickerStrike hit has a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3) to extend Endless Thirst's leech-cap bonus by 2s.

modifiers.name: Second Heartbeat
modifiers.text: A 20% chance per rank (up to 60% at 3/3) for a FlickerStrike hit to trigger an immediate bonus dash at one random additional enemy.

specializations.name: Reaper's Momentum
specializations.text: A kill from FlickerStrike adds 1 bonus target to your next dash per rank (up to 3 extra targets at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Chain Reaper
modifiers.text: Each bonus target granted by Reaper's Momentum also heals you for 3% of max HP per rank (up to 9% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Death Spiral
modifiers.text: A kill from one of Reaper's Momentum's bonus dash targets heals a flat 4% of max HP per rank (up to 12% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Undying
modifiers.text: Can't drop below 1 HP during a FlickerStrike dash - once per fight at rank 1, twice at rank 3.

skills.name: Bloodpact
skills.text: Automatically fires every 4s of the fight once available (no live input needed during an auto-battle): sacrifice 10% of your CURRENT HP at rank 1 - cost drops 2% per additional rank (6% HP at rank 3) - to deal double damage on that hit. Triple damage at rank 2, quadruple at rank 3. The sacrifice can never drop you below 1 HP.

specializations.name: Grim Bargain
specializations.text: A killing Bloodpact hit refunds 30% of the HP sacrificed for that use, at rank 1 - +20% per additional rank (70% refunded at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Blood for Blood
modifiers.text: Grim Bargain's refund scales up by 2% of the target's max HP per rank (up to +6% at 3/3), on top of its base refund.

modifiers.name: Debt Collector
modifiers.text: A non-lethal Bloodpact hit still refunds 15% of the sacrificed HP per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Clean Slate
modifiers.text: A successful Grim Bargain refund has a 25% chance per rank (up to 75% at 3/3) to also fully reset Bloodpact's cooldown.

specializations.name: Blood Sacrifice
specializations.text: Bloodpact's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s per point invested (3.5s at rank 1, down to 2s at rank 3+), so it fires more often across the fight.

modifiers.name: Triage
modifiers.text: Each prior Bloodpact use this fight discounts the NEXT use's HP cost by 3% per rank (up to -9% per prior use at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Warlord's Resolve
modifiers.text: Bloodpact's 3rd use also grants the party +5% damage per rank for 10s (up to +15% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Final Offering
modifiers.text: The last Bloodpact use of the fight costs 33% less HP per rank - completely free at 3/3. (inactive)

specializations.name: Martyrdom
specializations.text: Bloodpact instead shields your lowest-HP ally for 15s, worth 150% of the sacrificed HP at rank 1 - +50% per additional rank (250% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Guardian's Blood
modifiers.text: Martyrdom's shield also reflects 10% of absorbed damage per rank (up to 30% at 3/3) back at the attacker.

modifiers.name: Shared Pain
modifiers.text: Shielding an ally also heals you for 25% of the shield's value per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

modifiers.name: Last Rites
modifiers.text: A 33% chance per rank (up to 100% at 3/3) to prevent a downed ally's death once per fight.
